capability_requirements.description: Accessible DOM rendering with keyboard trap and ARIA live announcements
High-speed client-side secret and credential sanitization
Resilient idempotent local queueing in sessionStorage
Integration with append-only telemetry ingestion stream

candidate_options.name: Heavyweight Third-Party SDK (Sentry/LogRocket)
cons: Potential PII transmission to third party

candidate_options.name: Lightweight Vanilla Standard Web Component + Regex Sanitizer
pros: Runs in any browser without transpilation

selected_approach: Lightweight Vanilla Standard Web Component + Regex Sanitizer
justification: Provides highest security, zero vendor lock-in, pristine accessibility, zero bundle bloat (<10KB vs >80KB), and deterministic offline queueing.
